checks.name: typecheck
checks.cmd: npx tsc --noEmit -p . | grep -E '^src/' | cut -d'(' -f1 | sort | uniq -c

checks.name: offline-tests
checks.cmd: npx vitest run test/org.test.ts test/org-workflow.test.ts test/board.test.ts test/line-editor.test.ts test/repo.test.ts test/followup.test.ts test/followup-workflow.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests '

checks.name: gitignore
checks.cmd: git check-ignore -v .env personas worker/node_modules docs/node_modules docs/architecture/test-results docs/architecture/dist/index.open.html | awk '{print $2 "  <-  " $1}'; git check-ignore -q docs/architecture/dist/index.html || echo 'docs/architecture/dist/index.html  <-  (除外されていない)'; test -z "$(git log --all --oneline -- .env)" && echo '.env  <-  (コミットされた履歴なし)'

checks.name: no-auth
checks.cmd: for f in worker/src/broker.ts worker/src/server.ts sandbox/server.mjs; do printf '%s: ' $f; grep -ciE 'authorization|bearer|x-kobun|api[-_]?key' $f; done; true

checks.name: catalog
checks.cmd: printf '指標の数: '; grep -c "key: '" src/metrics/catalog.ts; printf 'token / usage を含む行: '; grep -ciE 'token|usage' src/metrics/catalog.ts; true
